item.title: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
item.description: China has rolled out a cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology, one of America’s largest memory chip makers, in apparent retaliation after US allies in Asia and Europe unveiled fresh restrictions on the sale of key technology to Beijing.
